name: AuthKeeper
tagline: A 2FA/TOTP authenticator with an encrypted vault, QR enroll and backup.
description: Store and generate TOTP/HOTP two-factor codes in a password-encrypted local vault. Enroll accounts by pasting an otpauth URI or scanning a QR image, see live rotating codes, and export/import an encrypted backup. Your secrets never leave the device — a desktop authenticator that you actually own.
aiStack: Python (tkinter + CLI), pyotp, cryptography, segno, Pillow
